source: the approved design of #720 (the product owner, 2026-10-30), .garura/project/issues/720/specs/design.md

changes.old: update, edit and delete plans, and keep the plan file and its tracker issues in step. Orchestration only.
changes.new: a working session on one plan: a person gives instructions in their own words, the play checks each one against the product model, the rules for GitHub and how an epic holds its work, keeps a running list, and on a plain "approved" lands every change at once in the plan file, GitHub and the product model, on the plan's own branch. Orchestration only.

changes.old: - Goal: After any change, the plan file and the tracker agree.
changes.new: - Goal: After the person approves, the plan file, GitHub and the product model agree, and nothing beyond the approved list has changed.

changes.old: - Limit: It never cuts or merges a branch and never changes code — that is the implementation plays' work.
changes.new: - Limit: Nothing is written before a plain "approved". It changes a plan only on the plan's own branch; it cuts a branch only when the plan has none (main's plan file first, then the cut), never merges one, and never changes code.

changes.old: - Fails if: a change lands in the plan file and not in the tracker, or the other way round.
changes.new: - Fails if: a write happens before approval; a change lands in one of the three and not the others; a change the person did not approve lands; a plan is changed anywhere but on its own branch.

changes.old: - Checked by: a compare of the plan file with the tracker finds no difference after each change.
changes.new: - Checked by: after landing, a compare of the plan file, GitHub and the model finds no difference, and a compare against the approved list finds nothing extra.

changes.old: # Feature: Update, edit or delete a plan file, and connect it to its issues
changes.new: # Feature: The /update-plan session — instructions, checks, one approval, one landing on the plan's branch

changes.old: add, move, drop or finish a node, or delete a plan — in the plan file and in the tracker (create, re-parent, close) together. Work can go on in the plan file; the sync brings the tracker up to date.
changes.new: a person opens a session on one plan with `/update-plan <id>` or a description, gives instructions in their own words, and approves; the play lands the changes in the plan file and GitHub together, on the plan's own branch. Changing an epic's or a story's text is one more instruction (#909 folded in).

changes.old: - Goal: Any change to a plan reaches both the plan file and the tracker.
changes.new: - Goal: Every instruction the person approved reaches the plan file and GitHub, in one landing on the plan's branch, and they agree afterwards.

changes.old: - Limit: Never touches branches or code.
changes.new: - Limit: Nothing is written before a plain "approved". It never merges a branch and never changes code; it cuts the plan's branch only when the plan has none, with main's plan file set first.

changes.old: - Fails if: the tracker is left behind, or a dropped node stays open.
changes.new: - Fails if: a write happens before approval; GitHub is left behind or ahead of the plan file; a dropped item stays open; anything changes that the person did not approve; it switches away from a branch with uncommitted work.

changes.old: - Checked by: a test edits a plan three ways and the compare finds no difference.
changes.new: - Checked by: a test session with several instructions (add, move, drop, finish, change a story's text, set Status and Direction), approved once; the compare of the plan file with GitHub finds no difference, and nothing outside the list changed.
